title: OpenVA Agent Enrichment Request
description: Host-neutral request shared by the MCP enrich_inventory tool and the match-service /v1/enrich endpoint. It carries only bounded vendor-identity fields and an optional source-type filter. It must never carry workspace credentials, file or document contents, workspace identifiers, or any field other than those below; additionalProperties is false so unrelated workspace columns cannot enter OpenVA.

rows.description: Bounded batch of vendor-identity rows. Processed in input order; duplicates are preserved.

source_types.description: Optional canonical source-type filter. Omitted (or null) means all canonical source types. An unknown type simply yields no sources for that type.

row.description: One vendor identity. At least one identity field must be non-empty; row_id is an opaque correlation id echoed back without reinterpretation and is never treated as a workspace identifier.

row_id.description: Opaque caller correlation id. Echoed verbatim.
